title: Mostly create
description: A create modpack with a low tech focus used within our SMP
body:
Light tech focused create modpack which aims to make a Create enviroment that still has a vanilla-ish vibe. In essence meaning yes to more automatisation stuff and quality of life changes but a no to teleportation or highly specific ~~or detailed~~ detailing blocks.  
This modpack ~~is~~ will mostly used within our SMP server and might be adjusted later on to the needs there.

This pack is heavily based on and inspired by the [just Create modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/just-create-smp/).

## Optional mods
- [Borderless Window](https://modrinth.com/mod/CnalMsa0) → Enable per personal preference. This can slightly reduce game render performance in fullscreen.
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/YL57xq9U) → Optional due to breaking create's nixie tube rendering on trains when being installed. Does allow shaders which we would like to play with sometimes.

## Server creation note
The whole pack can be ran on a server, however one does have to remove the reforgedplaymod, freecam and Pretty Rain mods for the server to start.
